request.user:
Subject: Zoology
Question type: single-correct (exactly one option is right)

Which of the following pairs of hormones are not antagonistic (having opposite effects) to each other?
(A) Parathormone – Calcitonin
(B) Insulin - Glucagon
(C) Aldosterone Atrial Natriuretic Factor
(D) Relaxin - Inhibin

result.working: Parathormone raises blood calcium while calcitonin lowers it, so they are antagonistic. Insulin lowers blood glucose while glucagon raises it, so they are antagonistic. Aldosterone promotes Na+ and water reabsorption and raises BP, while ANF causes vasodilation and lowers BP, so they are antagonistic. Relaxin relaxes the pubic symphysis and dilates the cervix during parturition. Inhibin suppresses FSH secretion. Their actions are unrelated, so they are not antagonistic.
